deltas.anthropic_json: Return one JSON object only. JSON inside one markdown fence is accepted, but no prose may make the object ambiguous.
deltas.gemini_pips: For UP use 0 <= expected_pips_min <= expected_pips_max; for DOWN use expected_pips_min <= expected_pips_max <= 0; for FLAT both values are 0.
deltas.openai_reversal: expected_reversal_flag is true only when a later stated horizon reverses the stated path direction; include that reversal horizon and do not contradict the stage directions.
